zh-Hans: 快捷窗口恢复默认置顶，可用顶部图钉切换；通用设置中移除了重复开关。
自动定位到文件动态后会保留最新文件的选中状态。「新动态」提示会在约 5 分钟后自动消失。
更改监听目录时，冻结的文件动态时间线会恢复刷新。
en: The Quick Panel stays on top by default again. Use its pin button to toggle this directly.
Jumping to recent activity keeps the newest file selected. The new activity indicator clears automatically after about five minutes.
Changing the monitored folders refreshes a frozen activity timeline.
